C-ZERO-CLICK-MEETING-INTAKE.IntentSummary: Complete the existing protocol extraction path with a direct Meetings upload action, exact source-based navigation and idempotent persistence, while preserving manual corrections and avoiding every confirmation or approval stage.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: define the one-step protocol intake and exception states

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The primary path is upload, immutable save, automatic meeting creation and immediate exact navigation; partial extraction remains a working editable meeting and no confirmation screen appears.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: add compact responsive upload and source navigation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Desktop and mobile expose one stable upload action, visible progress, precise success/error copy and an immutable-source link without adding modal steps.

T-003.Title: kafedra-data: enforce source-version idempotency and preserve corrections

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Repeated persistence of one source version returns one meeting and does not rewrite operator-edited fields, agenda, decisions, calendar rows or review history.

T-004.Title: kafedra-feature: connect canonical meeting query and immediate UI opening

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Meeting queries expose source document metadata, and the UI opens the exact meeting created by the existing worker from the accepted document id.

T-005.Title: kafedra-tests: prove complete, partial and repeated imports on desktop and mobile

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit/integration and Playwright cover exact source navigation, editable partial results, immutable source access, manual correction preservation, repeat idempotency and regression of manual meetings.

T-006.Title: kafedra-release: verify unchanged schema/version and full offline delivery

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No migration or VERSION change is introduced; full GRACE, project, release and offline checks succeed on one unchanged head before exact-head squash merge, post-merge CI and archive-only transition.
